description: Refresh the Locus Agent index for the current session's checkout after creating or editing Agent files. Returns projectAgentRoot (<current-checkout>/Locus/agent/), userAgentRoot (the installation's user-agents/ directory), and the loaded Agent list with sources. Default new Agents to projectAgentRoot for team collaboration and version control; use userAgentRoot only for explicitly requested installation-level Agents shared across projects. Resolves roots without creating directories. Call before editing to choose the correct root, then after edits to validate discovery: project/both for project definitions, user/appUser for installation definitions.
